method: Public input PNGs only. Manually drawn target contours on keyframes, feature-based alignment, interpolation between registered keyframe contours with dense optical-flow guidance, skin and garment color constraints and local closed-form matting. The common excluded layer in the two supplied clips is identified by matching opaque pixels and jointly fitted at its soft boundary. Foreground RGB is locally unassociated with regularized color reconstruction; available registered background observations refine selected high-contrast edges in clip 1. No hidden source foreground or alpha is used.
target_policy: clip_1 retains only the long-haired woman wearing glasses. clip_2 retains the adult and child, including visible hair, clothing, hands and held phone. The blue-shirted bearded man and moving strip are excluded. Alpha is limited to the visible target contribution in each original frame; occluded anatomy is not completed.
